title: Active-learning virtual screen finds new Cryptosporidium parvum inhibitors
summary: A workflow combining Thompson Sampling, a pharmacophore model and a machine learning classifier screened a subset of 51 million virtual Enamine REAL compounds. Across two campaigns, 20 of 69 tested compounds (29%) were micromolar hits and eight had confirmed activity at or below 21 uM. Testing was in vitro, the hits are analogs of one chemical series, and chemist judgment also guided selection.
ai_technology: Thompson Sampling active-learning screen with a pharmacophore filter and a bagging classifier to select compounds

evidence.tested: Custom-synthesized compounds tested in C. parvum HCT-8 cell assays with EC50 determination across two campaigns.
evidence.unknown: In vivo efficacy; the publication date differs between Crossref (2026-10-30) and Europe PMC (2026-11-01).
evidence.ai_role: Selects compounds for synthesis and testing
